1.lead: A New York legend in a Berlin skyscraper. We gave it a look, a website and a film of its own.

sections.title: How we built it
text: We started from the hotel itself: ==art deco from Park Avenue, set inside the Zoofenster tower== above City West. We turned that into a visual identity and rebuilt the website around it, from the rooms and the spa to Lang Bar and Peacock Alley.
Then we shot the hotel the way guests live it: the lobby, the suites, the views and the bar after dark. The result is ==one consistent brand== across the website, social and the hotel itself.

role.deliverables: the brand identity, the redesigned website and the brand film.

2.lead: One scoop a day is an easy habit. Getting someone to try it for the first time is the hard part. We rebuilt the path from first click to first order.

sections.title: Overview
text: AG1 came to us to make paid traffic work harder in Europe. We redesigned the website and built a system of advertorials and landing pages for each traffic source. Every click now lands on a page that ==continues the conversation the ad started==.

sections.title: The anatomy
text: The advertorial tells the story and earns the reader’s trust. The landing page turns that interest into a clear offer. The website closes the sale and brings people back.
Every page was built to be tested, so the team can ==swap angles, headlines and offers== without rebuilding the funnel.

role.deliverables: the redesigned website, a series of advertorials and landing pages for paid traffic.

3.lead: A mobile studio’s first PC game had one shot at getting noticed. The reveal trailer took off, with 100M+ views in its first month.

sections.title: How we made it
text: The world’s worst airline, in under a minute. We built the trailer around ==pure in-flight chaos==: turbulence, flying luggage and a crew one bad call away from disaster. Every beat sets up the game and lands a joke.

card.label: One launch
card.headline: 1 trailer. Dozens of shorts. 100M+ views.
card.copy: Every moment of the trailer was built to stand on its own, then cut into ==vertical shorts== for TikTok, Reels and YouTube Shorts. One film turned into a month of content that kept the game in the feed.
card.hand: Built to be clipped, shared and replayed.

role.deliverables: the reveal trailer and a series of shorts for social.

items.label: views across all platforms in the first month

results.note: Within the first month after release.

4.lead: Mabrook is Arabic for “congratulations”. The app packs short video, live streams, games, music challenges and a marketplace into one login. The website had to explain all of it in one scroll.

sections.title: How we rebuilt it
text: A super app is a hard thing to explain. We built the site as ==one continuous story==: start with the feed, then music challenges, game battles, AI personalization and the marketplace. Each feature gets one idea, one screen and one line.

Real app screens and motion do the talking, not feature lists. The page is split for ==both sides of the platform==: creators who want to go live and get paid, and brands that want to reach their communities.

role.deliverables: the redesigned mabrook.ai, from structure and copy flow to the final build.

5.lead: Europe’s biggest poker room, the home of the WSOP Europe, needed a brand to match. We built it end to end.

sections.title: How we built it
text: We created ==one kingdom across every touchpoint==: a new identity, a website designed around the guest’s day, and a brand film that opens it.

We spent five days on site filming the resort live: the poker room, the casino floor, the suites, the spa and the restaurant. The result is a ==full-cycle brand== that feels the same online and on the floor.

role.deliverables: the Kings identity, the website and the brand film.

6.lead: In real estate, people don’t choose an agency. They choose a person. We turned Sergey into the agent clients trust before the first viewing.

sections.title: How we built it
text: Buying or selling a home is one of the biggest decisions people make, and they want someone they can rely on. We built Sergey’s brand around that: ==a clear position, a calm, confident look== and one tone of voice across the website, social and listings.

The website has one job: more inquiries. It shows his properties and closed deals, explains how he works and makes it easy to book a call. New clients ==arrive already trusting him==, so the first meeting starts with the property, not the pitch.

role.deliverables: the personal brand identity and a website built to generate inquiries.

7.lead: Antiques, gems and Swiss watches deserve a site that feels as valuable as what it buys. We redesigned Antiquerus from the ground up.

sections.title: How we rebuilt it
text: Antiquerus buys everything from Fabergé-era silver to Tibetan thangkas and Cartier. We turned a long, complex catalog into ==a calm, gallery-like experience==, where every category has its own page, its own visuals and a short path to an appraisal.
The new structure was built for search from day one. The site climbed in search rankings, and more visitors went all the way to ==request a valuation==.

card.label: One catalog
card.headline: 500+ visuals. 60+ pages. One visual language.
card.copy: We drew ==every image and interface element in-house==: icons, illustrations and object visuals for each category, from gold and diamonds to porcelain and icons.

role.deliverables: the redesigned antiquerus.ru, 500+ custom images and elements, and an SEO-ready structure.

8.lead: A free-to-play card battler with a whole multiverse behind it. We gave it a home, its heroes and a first glimpse of gameplay.

sections.title: How we built it
text: DeckForge mixes ==relic cards, seasonal updates and endless replayability== across PC, mobile and consoles. We built the website as a gateway into that multiverse: the world, the heroes and the platforms are one click from “Play”.
We designed the characters and illustrations that give the universe its faces, then cut a gameplay teaser that shows ==how a run actually feels==: draw, play, forge, repeat.

card.label: One universe
card.headline: 1 website. A cast of heroes. 1 teaser.
card.copy: Every piece was made by one team, so the site, the characters and the teaser ==share a single visual language==, ready for every platform the game ships on.
card.hand: Forge your deck. We forged the rest.

role.deliverables: the DeckForge website, character designs and illustrations, and the gameplay teaser.
